app.name: Tasmee' — تسميع
app.tagline: Xifidhso Qur'aanka — codkaaga waligiis kama bixi doono qalabkaaga
recite.instruction: Riix makarafoonka oo xifdi — kelmad kastoo sax ah ayaa ka soo muuqan doonta meesheeda
recite.paused: Waa la joojiyay — riix si aad u sii wadato
recite.tryAgain: Lama garan — mar kale isku day kelmadda xigta
mic.needPermission: Waxaa loo baahan yahay ogolaanshaha makarafoonka
mic.blockedTitle: Makarafoonka waa la xannibay — isku day kuwan:
mic.openNewWindow: Bogga ku fur daaqad gaar ah, ka dibna riix makarafoonka
mic.iosSteps: iPhone (Safari): taabo AA ee xariiqda ciwaanka → Dejinta Boggaa → Makarafoon → Ogolow
mic.androidSteps: Android (Chrome): taabo sumadda qufulka → Ogolaansho → Makarafoon → Ogolow
mic.typeFallback: Halkan ku qor kelmadaha si aad u tababarto adigoo aan cod isticmaalin
mic.notSupported: Biraawsarkaagu ma taageerayo garashada hadalka oo ku dhex jirta — isku day Chrome ama Safari
engine.download: Waa la soo dejinayaa matoorka akhriska (hal mar oo keliya, wuxuu ku kaydsan yahay biraawsarkaaga)
engine.failed: Matoorka lama soo rarin — hubi xiriirkaaga oo mar kale isku day
level.label: Heerka adkaanta
level.beginnerHint: Aad u fudud — waxay ku fiican tahay carruurta iyo tallaabooyinka hore
level.intermediateHint: Kelmadu waa inay noqotaa mid sax ah oo cad
level.preciseHint: Isku ekaansho adag — isu diyaari inaad ku akhrido macallin hortiisa
level.suggestUp: Natiijooyin aad u fiican! Ma diyaar u tahay inaad isku dayto heer sare?
plan.reviewFirst: Aan marka hore dib u eegno qaybtii shalay
progress.title: Horumarkaaga
groups.title: Kooxaha
settings.aboutText: Waa mashruuc sadaqo bilaash ah (sadaqo jaariya ah). Akhriskaaga waxaa lagu shaqeeyaa qalabkaaga kaliya, marnaba lama soo geliyo.
settings.offline: Wuu shaqeeyaa adiga oo aan internet lahayn kadib booqashada koowaad
error.generic: Wax baa qaldamay — fadlan mar kale isku day
level.ijazahHint: Isku ekaansho xarafba xaraf ah — loogu talagalay shahaadada ijaasadda rasmiga ah ee macallin
nav.frontPagesInProgress: Boggagga Al-Faatixa iyo bilowga Al-Baqarah waa la diyaarinayaa
record.busy: Waa la diraya duubistii hore, hal daqiiqad…
record.error.format: Biraawsarkaagu ma taageerayo qaabka duubista codka ee loo baahan yahay
record.error.network: Lama gaari karin serverka — hubi xiriirkaaga internetka
record.error.generic: Wax baa qaldamay intii duubista socotay — mar kale isku day
server.interimNote: Waxaa hadda la isticmaalayaa garashada biraawsarkaaga (ku meel gaar)
server.privacyServer: Codkaaga waxaa lagu shaqeeyaa serverkeenna, marnaba lama kaydiyo
server.privacyInterim: Garashada hadalku hadda wuxuu ka shaqeynayaa biraawsarkaaga — server lama xiriirin

cert.empty: Wali shahaado ma jirto — dhammee suurad si aad u hesho mid
